title: Olivia and the Long Stick
subtitle: A stick can borrow strength
author: Olivia's Shelf
blurb: Olivia cannot lift a heavy lid — until Elon slides a long stick under it and shows her how a lever borrows strength.

magic.launch: The little rocket pushed the air, and the air pushed back.
magic.drop: Everything falls. That pull has a name: gravity.

grok.instructions: Warm, clear storyteller reading a science picture book to a child. Curious, never lecturing. Pause at full stops.

openai.instructions: Warm, clear storyteller reading a science picture book to a child. Curious, never lecturing. Pause at full stops.

pages.heading: Too heavy
pages.text: {Olivia} tugged a heavy lid. It would not move. "{Elon:elon/look}," she said. "My arms are not enough."

pages.heading: A long helper
pages.text: {Elon:elon/teach} slid a long {stick} under the lid and put a block in the middle. "Push the long end {down}."

pages.heading: The lid lifts
pages.text: Olivia pushed. The short end rose. The lid {lifted}. "That stick is a {lever}," said Elon.

pages.heading: The quiet middle
pages.text: "The block is the {fulcrum}," said {Elon:elon/teach}. "The quiet middle the stick turns on."

pages.heading: Longer is easier
pages.text: "A longer push side makes the lift {easier}," said Elon. "A see-saw is a lever. So is a bottle opener."

pages.heading: Keep asking why
pages.text: "Why can a small person lift a big one on a see-saw?" asked {Olivia:olivia/ask}. "Sit farther from the middle," said {Elon:elon/teach}.

end.heading: The End
end.text: A lever is a stick that turns on a quiet middle. Push the long side. The short side lifts.
end.prompt: What heavy thing would you try a stick on tomorrow?

credits: Painted for Olivia's Shelf. Elon is a picture-book inventor who teaches physics; this is not a biography.

options.label: a stick that turns on a middle

questions.right: Yes! A lever turns on a fulcrum.
questions.wrong: Elon said a lever is a stick that turns on a quiet middle.

options.label: the quiet middle the stick turns on

questions.right: That's right. The fulcrum is the middle.
questions.wrong: The block in the middle is the fulcrum.

questions.q: How do you make a lift easier?
questions.right: Yes. A longer push side borrows more strength.
